title: Binary multiplication state work
statement: For natural numbers $\ell$ and $r$, define the state work recursively by $S_{\ell,0}=0$ and $S_{\ell,r+1}=S_{\ell,r}+A_\ell+M_\ell+1$, where $A_\ell$ is the binary scalar addition work and $M_\ell$ is the binary multiplication reduction work.
